minutes.headline: Conservation Commission approved a pool deck, a home rebuild and a 372,000 sq ft warehouse; one pool hearing continued.
minutes.summary: The commission, with four members present on Zoom, heard several wetlands hearings. It issued a negative determination for an above-ground pool, approved a Brookview Terrace home rebuild, and approved the warehouse notice of intent with a standard order of conditions. It continued the Butterfly Lane pool, Pleasant Street subdivision, Townsend Harbor and Flynn Road hearings, and issued a certificate of compliance. Next meeting will be on Zoom.

public_comment.topic: Chair invited public comment at the start; none raised.
Resident asked whether traffic impact on Lancaster Avenue and Route 2A was studied for the large warehouse; chair said traffic is a planning board matter outside the commission's jurisdiction.

what_happened.line: The commission approved a notice of intent for a warehouse at 535 Lancaster/Shirley Road with a standard order of conditions, 4-0.
It approved the demolition and reconstruction of a home at 40 Brookview Terrace as presented, 4-0.
It issued a negative determination for an above-ground pool with a deck at 91 Maple Parkway, 4-0.
It continued the Butterfly Lane pool and pavilion hearing to September 15 so the applicant can resubmit a fuller plan.
It continued the Pleasant Street subdivision hearing to October 6, and the Townsend Harbor Road and Flynn Road hearings to September 15.

why_it_matters: The warehouse approval sets wetlands conditions on a large commercial building. A resident asked about traffic, and the chair said traffic belongs to the Planning Board, so that question sits outside this commission's review.
The Pleasant Street subdivision is still undecided, so neighbors and abutters can still take part in the hearing when it returns.
watch_next: September 15: Butterfly Lane, Townsend Harbor Road and Flynn Road hearings resume.
October 6: Pleasant Street subdivision hearing resumes after the applicant consults DEP's reviewing agent.
